Where do we stand strategically? IFAS–EFAS matrix, strategy quadrant, and TOWS matrix.
Which macro factors affect the plan? Maps political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal factors along with their impact and likelihood.
How intense is competition in a sector? Assesses the five competitive forces of an industry to determine market attractiveness.
What are the site's potentials and constraints? Site condition assessment sheet: climate, topography, access, utilities, and views.
Which regulations apply and how large is the risk? Legal basis matrix, regulatory hierarchy, compliance testing, norm conflicts, and policy options with source traceability.
Have the experts reached agreement? Screens and validates items through several rounds of expert ratings (median, IQR, % agreement).
What themes emerge from interviews/FGDs? Coding of text segments, code frequency and co-occurrence for discourse, field notes, and FGD transcripts.
How do people use space? Summarize activity observations per zone and time into space-use patterns.
Does the building meet occupants' expectations? Building performance scores according to occupants, gaps against expectations, and improvement priorities.
Is the instrument reliable and does the intervention have an effect? Instrument validation, respondent profiles, experiments, intervention evaluation, and visualization of psychological results.

Which groups are problematic on two indicators at once? Items are mapped on two indicators and divided into four by mean/median/reference lines: IPA, Klassen Typology, or free quadrants (e.g. economic growth × poverty).

What themes emerge from interviews/FGDs, and do they differ by informant group? Qualitative data analysis like NVivo: attributed sources & cases, hierarchical nodes, two-coder coding, word frequency & word cloud, text search (KWIC), matrix coding, framework matrix, hierarchy chart, node clustering, and Cohen's κ.

Are the items of my psychological scale reliable, and how should respondents' scores be interpreted? Likert-scale item analysis: corrected item-total correlation, α if item deleted, Cronbach α, McDonald ω, total score, z, T, percentile, and norm categories.
Which factors are roots and which are effects? Influence hierarchy among elements and driving–dependence power classification.
How strongly do factors influence each other? Total relation matrix, prominence (D+R) and relation (D−R), cause/effect groups, influence map; can build the ISM SSIM (ISM–DEMATEL).
Who is the most influential actor in the network? Degree, closeness, and betweenness centrality among actors, plus network density.
How important is each criterion according to experts? Criteria weights from Saaty-scale pairwise comparisons, then alternative ranking.
Which alternative is closest to the ideal solution? Ranks alternatives by closeness to the ideal solution; weights can be taken from AHP (AHP–TOPSIS).

Does the ranking stay the same if the method differs? One decision matrix computed with SAW, WP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, PROMETHEE II, and MOORA; manual, AHP, Entropy, CRITIC, or BWM weights; agreement and sensitivity tests.
Do the project's benefits exceed its costs? NPV, BCR, IRR, and payback period from cost and benefit flows.
How long will the project take and which activities are critical? Activity schedule, float, critical path, and probability of on-time completion.
How does the organization perform from four perspectives? Indicator achievement in the financial, customer, internal process, and learning perspectives.

Which option is wise when future conditions are uncertain? Choosing an alternative when future conditions are uncertain: maximax, maximin, Hurwicz, Laplace, minimax regret, EMV, EVPI, and decision trees.

Are the differences/relationships in the data significant? Descriptives, frequencies, Shapiro–Wilk normality, correlation, linear regression (robust HC1, VIF), t-test + Levene, ANOVA + Welch + Bonferroni, Mann–Whitney, Wilcoxon, Kruskal–Wallis, χ² crosstab, Cronbach's α, factor analysis.
Is the latent construct model supported by the data? Outer loading, α, ρA, ρC, AVE, HTMT, Fornell–Larcker, R², f², VIF, indirect effects, bootstrapping (equivalent to the analysis in SmartPLS).
How well does the theoretical model fit the data? Maximum Likelihood estimation, CFA and structural models, χ², CFI, TLI, RMSEA (90% CI), SRMR, GFI, CR/AVE (equivalent to AMOS analysis).
How to manage the project's drawings, 3D models, BIM, and GIS? Manage project assets and create simple illustrations from images, OBJ/STL models, and metadata of other research formats locally.

Which spaces are the most integrated/accessible? Convex space graph or axial map (draw over a floor plan/map, import DXF/GeoJSON): global & R3 integration, choice, NACH/NAIN, intelligibility, color-gradient maps.

How deep are private spaces compared with the basic Javanese house? Space depth from the access point, Total Depth, living–family–kitchen room ratios, and comparison with the Javanese house Basic Depth Ratio (Tutuko, 2014); many houses at once.

Is the building envelope energy-efficient according to SNI? Wall (OTTV) and roof (RTTV) thermal transfer values according to SNI 6389:2020: assembly layers, WWR, shading SC, SF for 54 cities, building-mass orientation simulation.
How hot is the area and which scenario cools it? Import simulation results, temperature and wind maps, scenario comparison, and Urban Heat Island indicators.

How do sun, light, heat, sound, and wind affect building design? Building environment analysis like Ecotect: stereographic sun path, shading & shadow mask, clear-sky radiation per orientation, daylight factor, PMV/PPD & psychrometric chart, Sabine/Eyring reverberation time, and wind rose.
Are the components safe and reliable? Import FEA/CFD results, stress and thermal evaluation, FMEA, reliability, and design comparison.
How efficient is the production/service system? Queues, process simulation, ergonomics, inventory, scheduling, quality control, and industrial system optimization.
Which infrastructure assets most need attention? Performance of structures, transportation, hydrology, geotechnics, project risk, and evaluation of infrastructure alternatives.
How reliable and efficient is the power grid? Load profile, power quality, renewable energy, control, telecommunications, and network reliability analysis.

How to compute scientific quantities from experimental data? Linear algebra, roots of equations, integrals, Runge–Kutta, calibration regression, GUM, molar mass & reaction balancing, pH, diversity, Hardy–Weinberg, Michaelis–Menten, population projection, pollution index, Streeter–Phelps.

Does the exposure, test, drug, test item, or treatment have an effect? 2×2 table (OR, RR, χ²), diagnostic tests, IV bolus pharmacokinetics, test item analysis (KR-20), RAL/RAK experiments with the BNT test.

. A good analysis usually proceeds in order:
: What is happening around this problem?
(Scan the environment, site, regulations, and strategic position before developing solutions.)
: What do experts, users, and the field say?
(Expert consensus, interview/FGD coding, behavioral observation, post-occupancy evaluation, and questionnaire instruments.)
: Which factors are the main causes?
(Hierarchical structure, cause–effect, and actor networks to identify key factors.)
: Which option is best across multiple criteria?
(Multi-criteria decision making (MCDM): weight the criteria, then rank the alternatives.)
: Is this decision safe, feasible, and schedulable?
(Decisions under an uncertain future, cost–benefit feasibility, project scheduling, and organizational performance.)
: Are the relationships between variables statistically supported?
(Statistical tests, reliability, regression, and structural equation models for survey/measurement data.)
: What patterns, groups, or predictions are hidden in the data?
(Visual workflow: arrange data widgets → preprocessing → clustering/classification → evaluation, like Orange Data Mining.)
: How do the spaces and buildings perform?
(Spatial configuration, house depth, envelope energy, microclimate, and model/BIM/GIS assets.)
: Are the engineering systems reliable and efficient?
